grammar.title: 语法知识 一般现在时＆现在进行时
lines: 4 一般现在时（Simple Present) 描述习惯的状态、经常的动作和普遍真理。 主语 + is\am\are + 非动词、 主语 + 动词 常与时间状语词组一起使用，如 every…always, usually, often, sometimes… 等。 现在进行时（Present Continuous） 表示此时此刻正在进行的动作或者持续一段时间的动作。 主语 + is\am\are + doing 常与表示具体时间的状语词组一起使用，如 now, at the moment… 等。
I usually have lunch at 12:00. 我通常 12 点吃饭。
He usually draws at 7:00. 他通常 7 点画画。
It 's nice day today . 今天是个好天气。
But I am having lunch now . 但今天都这会了我才吃呢！
But he is drawing at the moment . 但他现在在画呢。

sentences.title: 单词句型 询问时间
lines: 3 They usually . .. but today, they are ...
特殊疑问词 + is/am/are + n. 特殊疑问词 + n. + is/am/are
What’s the time? What time is it?
It's 2:00. ⇔ It's two o'clock. It's 10:00. ⇔ It's ten o' clock. It's 3:00. ⇔ It's three o' clock.
He usually shaves at seven o'clock every day, but today, he is shaving at 8:00.
